Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (5)
Annihilation.
The Demon Army had already lost eight Genesis Knights. The number of disappeared fleets was soon approaching ten thousand, and as Rondo had said, Chiron had not even properly used his sword yet.
“That vile, black land opening its maw and chewing up the White Fleet is chilling enough... what in the world are we to do.”
“What do you mean, what are we to do. Even so, the enemy's Genesis Knight count is only five! In the end, we will win the fight. Isn't that right, Lord Rondo!”
To be terrified, or to scream in order to forcefully push away the terror.

Rondo watched the faces of the Demon Army executives and swallowed a sigh. It was a relief that there were more of the latter, but if things continued this way, it was inevitable that their morale would shatter in an instant.

'As we lose troops, the restrictions of interdimensional interference are gradually strengthening. Don't tell me Chiron controlling the Black Sea is also affecting the maintenance of the dimensional gates? Or is it perhaps the will of Malugia at work...'

Either way, disasters were piling up for the Demon Army. And in the midst of it all, the Black Sea churned violently, following Chiron's gaze and eyes. The sight of that vile, black land opening its maw and chewing up the White Fleet was chilling enough, but now, Rondo could also see Chiron's sword shining pure white.

“Hurry and send out more fleets. Continue to include Genesis Knights! We must move with the goal of maintaining over a thousand fleets on the front lines again. Create a situation where they have no choice but to bring out that main cannon again!”
Intuitively, Rondo was realizing that he had made a mistake. Temporarily reducing the fleet deployment because the Lafrarosa's main cannon was a burden was clearly a mistake.
To send out over a thousand ships at once again, it seemed he would have to pay an even greater price than before.
“Yes, come... all of you. It has been a truly long time since I have had an enemy that did not flee before me.”
Geuuuuu, kiiiiiiing...!
A storm of aura was extending from the blade of Barisada like a cone. In the blink of an eye, that storm was seen growing large enough to more than cover a single White Fleet ship.
Could something like that be called just a single sword?
Chiron looked not as if he were holding a sword, but a fortress transformed to be easily held in his hand, or a part of great nature like a mountain or a sea.

The blade that had grown so large moved with surprising lightness and speed, and Chiron smirked as he swung a horizontal slash towards the fleet that was covering the dimensional gates. Because of the endlessly extended blade, there was no need to even fire a sword-aura to strike the ships.
The sword that had become a storm swept through the fleet once.
If the sky were a single, endlessly vast sheet of glass, if that glass were to suddenly shatter, this is what the scene would look like.
For a moment, a sharp crack appeared in the middle of the sky, and that crack expanded as fast as light, tearing apart the ships that were below it.
Even though about fifty ships were being destroyed by a single sword strike, not only was there no explosion, but not even a shockwave was generated.
The white fleets were just crumbling, as if a current of water were being gently parted. Although countless fragments poured into the empty air, that too was only for a moment.
The house-sized fragments soon became the size of boulders, the boulders soon became pebbles, and the pebbles soon became single, shining particles.
The white fleets struck by Chiron's blow were scattering somewhere without a sound. For a while, the sky became as bright as midday from the shining particles created as the fleet was destroyed.
Rondo's words were right. Compared to his sword, the authority to command the Black Sea was nothing more than a trivial trick.
“This is insane, what was that again, what just happened!?”
“He destroyed the first rank of our fleet with a single sword strike...?”
The terror grew.
To the Demon Army, Chiron Runcandel was originally a familiar opponent. Because in every dimension, he would resist fiercely and then meet his end.
The Chiron of this world was different.

The members of the Demon Army had thought they had been aware of that fact from the beginning. Furthermore, they had been confident that no matter how strong this world's Chiron and the Vamel Alliance were, they had brought a force that was bound to win.
Terror is bound to shake confidence.
Even Rondo was momentarily doubting his own judgment. Was it right to continue fighting like this? Was it even possible to defeat that man without Kelliac?
'...The strategy cannot be revised.'
There was no turning back.
In a way, that wasn't a story that only applied to the Vamel Alliance. The Demon Army had also had its entire main force struck by Malugia a while ago, and even now, their troop losses were severe.
If they were to retreat now with no gains, the coalition would take Solderet's arrangement with the greatest of ease, and naturally, the war would only become more difficult in the future.
Chwaaaak, piiit...!
The storm that was Barisada continued to swallow and decompose the White Fleet.
At the advance of a single human, the front line of the fleet that had conquered all dimensions was slowly being pushed back.
Furthermore, Chiron was still not using his full strength. The same was true for the other Genesis Knights fighting alongside him.
“The Patriarch has opened the path. Secure the front line!”
Jin shouted as he stood next to Chiron. Behind the five Genesis Knights, the superhumans of the coalition who had exited Laprarosa and the fleet were flocking.

The sky was still exploding as the cannonballs of the two fleets clashed every time Chiron's sword momentarily paused. The superhumans were able to quickly join the front lines, supported by Murakan, Bale, and the fleet's shields.
“This is shocking, Father.”
“Is that so? It is still too early.”
Tuk, Chiron lightly patted Jin's shoulder once.

“Youngest, you must be feeling it too. The enemies have started to send out more Genesis Knights. Originally, it would be best to pull back our front line before they all come out and activate the Plutonian Cannon.”
Jin had thought so too. However, the reason Jin had called all the superhumans to the front line was because Chiron had not given a separate signal.
Confidence.
Chiron was not hiding his confidence that he could cut down all of them, no matter how many Genesis Knights came.
“They still do not know me. And those who do not know me can never withstand my sword.”
No matter how many more fleets came out, no matter how many more Genesis Knights came out, he could easily annihilate them once.
That was what Chiron was saying. And in Jin's view, there was no room for doubt in those words.
“What should we do?”

“Still, as they are Genesis Knights, there will be those who gain a sudden enlightenment while withstanding my sword. Of course, they still won't be unscathed. Make sure they cannot attempt to survive, make sure they cannot create a variable, and finish them.”
“I will obey.”
For a while after the conversation ended, the sight of the storm of Barisada that had been sweeping the battlefield disappearing as if it were a lie followed.
The White Fleet, which had not dared to advance in that gap, hastily tidied its front lines, and the fleet that had been unable to exit the dimensional gate also began to increase its speed.
The reason Chiron had stopped the storm was to gauge.
Whether the enemies would continue to move as he had predicted, or whether they would show a change in strategy upon seeing the storm cease.
Rondo Zipple had already finished giving his orders a while ago. To push in more fleets and Genesis Knights, to secure the front lines somehow.

The movement of a fleet is naturally slower than the movement of a single person, Chiron. Furthermore, since the Demon Army was in a state of being overwhelmed by Chiron's martial prowess, they had no choice but to continue being dragged around.
The Demon Army, expanding their front line and emerging from the dimensional gates, were feeling a sense of unease at the fact that Chiron's sword had suddenly subsided.
'Chiron Runcandel and the Vamel Alliance were already overwhelming us. There is no way a backlash or demonic transformation could have suddenly come upon him. But why...?'
'We just hastily took our positions because the path suddenly started to open, but this looks as if... they have lured us in, doesn't it?'
'Don't tell me it's to use the main cannon? No, to think that, there are too many of the Vamel Alliance's superhumans in the cannon's strike range!'
The commanders of each fleet and the Genesis Knights could not read Chiron's intention.
There was no way they could think that he was planning to finish them all off on his own, without Lafrarosa's main cannon.

The Demon Army was forming a proper line for the first time since Chiron and the Genesis Knights began their feats. Paradoxically, the fact that it was so was giving the Demon Army a great sense of humiliation.
Ten people.

The number of Genesis Knights on board the White Fleet this time was a whopping ten. Although they were all absolute rulers without dispute in their own dimensions, to Chiron, they looked like just special soldiers. Just as the dead Andrei had expressed.
The Vamel Alliance and the Demon Army exchanged only naval cannon fire for a while.

Because the coalition had to wait for Chiron to move first, and the Demon Army had to grasp how he would move. Even if they had secured the front line again and sent out more Genesis Knights than ever before, they could not move recklessly.
Above all, the Demon Army was making the judgment that now that ten Genesis Knights had taken their positions, they could handle any situation that arose.

They were certain that even if the coalition had hidden a dimensional gate and used it to pull back Chiron and all their main forces to the rear and then fired the Plutonian Cannon, they would not be annihilated like before.
'As long as the move that Chiron and the coalition has prepared does not go far beyond our expectations, Lord Rondo's main force will now come out...'
The moment a commander thought that far.

Suddenly, Chiron began to stride forward. Allies and enemies alike sharpened their senses and followed his steps with their eyes. It felt as if his footsteps were louder than the exploding naval cannons. It felt as if they were vibrating the battlefield even more greatly.
Soon, Chiron said in a low voice.
“From now on, I will show you bastards what the sky of this world is.”
Runcandel Ultimate Technique
Realm of Emptiness
The end of the sword, wielded by Shiron Runcandel, was about to begin.
